summary: 多币种/汇率（WP-FX）契约冻结首片 on BASE 15cf20c, docs-only. Per Lead ruling C (the BASE PH-308 exact allowlist has no docs/adr entry and the spec itself asks for contract freeze rather than an ADR file), the frozen multi-currency/FX contract is written into project/specs/PH-308.md instead of creating docs/adr/0015-multi-currency-fx.md. The frozen text covers: reporting currency (org-level CNY) vs functional currency (ISO 4217 on every money fact, frozen in terms/confirmation snapshots); append-only versioned FX rate snapshots keyed by organization/base/quote/business effective date/source/version with Decimal rate (no float, unique effective version, no lookback fallback, no reciprocal auto-derivation, missing rate rendered as missing); conversion boundary semantics (convert once at each boundary, persist fx_rate_ref plus original currency/amount, ROUND_HALF_UP to integer cents exactly once, aggregate already-rounded cents, never sum originals then convert, no client-supplied converted amounts); cross-owner ownership boundaries (contracts owns functional-currency contract lines/terms, settlement owns settlement/open-item/clearance currency plus fx ref, management_revenue derives reporting read-only from approved terms, cash stays bank-currency with foreign cash/exchange gain-loss explicitly out of scope, costing/time unchanged); read-only display/reconciliation rules (show original + reporting values and rate ref, missing never 0/default rate, stable issue codes required when implemented, role rules owner/finance rates, auditor read, pm project summary, member denied, disabled-module history read, unauth 403); canonical/API/migration boundaries (no new canonical/model/migration/route in this slice, PH-321 implementation must plan any new canonical and migrate via explicit migration, no implicit recomputation of history); 12 rejection cases; acceptance/completion and an explicit not-implemented list. No product code, model, migration, schema, route, canonical event or docs/adr file was written; no existing write path or business fact changed.
